title: How Many Massages After BBL?
meta_description: There is no agreed number of massages after a BBL. What The Aesthetic Society and a narrative review say, when to start, and what to ask your surgeon.
excerpt: There is no agreed number of massages after a BBL. Here is what The Aesthetic Society and a narrative review actually say, what massage can and can't do, and the questions to ask your surgeon before you book sessions.
quick_answer:
How many massages do you need after a BBL?

There is no agreed number. The Aesthetic Society says your surgeon may recommend lymphatic massage. A narrative review reports 2 to 3 times a week for 3 to 4 weeks, in cosmetic surgery generally, not BBL. Follow your surgeon's schedule, and ask for it before you book sessions.

notes: Quotes came through WebFetch, whose extraction model caps a quote at about 125 characters, so long sentences are split or end early; the two ASPS PDFs were read with pdftotext instead (the report PDF exceeded WebFetch's size limit, so it was fetched with plain curl). Title and H2 wording kept; opening H2 added, with the plan's fallback wording in the first lines, since the practice has given no schedule (Marxen 2023, Level of Evidence 5, does not mention BBL).
